findings: Command regular-file validation and raw acquisition were outside the recorded terminal guard.
A heartbeat event-stop exception could skip the join attempt.
A final atomic save failure could leave RUNNING on disk without a full terminal JSON fallback.
limitations: These controls are authored and have not been executed.
If atomic result persistence fails, the on-disk result may remain RUNNING; the captured raw job log contains the complete FAIL terminal JSON.
A failure of both persistence and the fallback output stream cannot create durable bytes; the original primary exception is still preserved.
Core admission, archive reader, marker interpretation and root-cause limits are unchanged.
